chapters.label: Greeting & Introduction
chapters.summary: Agent welcomes the customer and introduces themselves.

chapters.label: Identity Verification
chapters.summary: Agent requests and verifies the customer's account details and security information.

chapters.label: Problem Statement
chapters.summary: Customer explains their request to set up automatic monthly transfers to a new savings account.

chapters.label: Investigation & Discussion
chapters.summary: Agent confirms account details, discusses transfer frequency, and calculates the transfer amount.

chapters.label: Resolution & Next Steps
chapters.summary: Agent sets up the transfers, sends a confirmation email, and explains how to manage them.

chapters.label: Options & Explanation
chapters.summary: Agent explains how to pause or cancel the automatic transfers.

chapters.label: Closing
chapters.summary: Customer thanks the agent and the call concludes.
